name: EAAA India Alternatives Limited
summary: EAAA India Alternatives Limited is an investment firm focused on Private Credit, Infrastructure, Real Estate, and Private Equity, specializing in Private Credit, Special Situation, Distressed Debt, Infrastructure Debt, Real Estate Debt, and Private Equity strategies. The firm primarily targets investments in office properties, mid-income and affordable housing developments, energy assets, renewable energy projects, climate mitigation and adaptation initiatives, operating infrastructure assets, and mid-stage operating companies. It focuses its investments in India. The firm seeks to provide structured credit and financing solutions to corporates, projects, or sponsors across the risk spectrum…
